Fierce '''battles''' occurred in the skies above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="SoT" /> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="TORE" /> The fights scattered the surface of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] wrecks that quickly disappeared under the sands.<ref name="SoT" />
